name: patent
title: Patent
description: A patent attorney's theme drawn as a patent drawing sheet in black ink on white: every service is a figure of hatched parts on a dash-dot centre line, tagged with reference numerals and captioned FIG. 1, FIG. 2.

tokens.--font-sans: humanist sans of all running text, titles and the menu
tokens.--font-slab: slab of the FIG. captions, numerals, fees, site title, telephone and dates
tokens.--font-mono: paragraph numbers [0001] in page text, and code
tokens.--text-small: small text: labels, credentials, block headings, footer
tokens.--caption-size: size of the FIG. captions under every figure
tokens.--color-bg: the white drawing board: page background and the fill of drawn parts
tokens.--color-text: ink of all lettering: titles, text, numerals, captions
tokens.--color-muted: secondary lettering: descriptions, opening lines, credentials, paragraph numbers, footer
tokens.--color-ink: every drawn line: part outlines, centre and lead lines, sheet frame, rules, boxes, focus ring
tokens.--measure: widest a column of reading text gets
tokens.--gutter: space kept at each side of the page
tokens.--cell: width of one drawn part; three make a service figure
tokens.--fig-zone: height above the parts for reference numerals and lead lines
tokens.--fig-depth: height of the band the parts sit in, centre line through its middle
tokens.--stroke: weight of part outlines, sheet frame, fee box, focus ring
tokens.--hair: weight of centre lines, lead lines, hatching and rules
tokens.--hatch-gap: distance between the lines of the hatching
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the fee box
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between a title and its description
tokens.--space-2: small gap: around labels and inside boxes
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and inside the sheet
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: between columns and above the drawing sheet
